terms.gloss: Good Friday, the day of Preparation
terms.comment: Greek παρασκευή, the day of preparation before the Sabbath, the Friday of the Passion (Lewis & Short). In Greek every Friday is still παρασκευή, and this one is Great Friday (Μεγάλη Παρασκευή).

evidence: Miss. Rōm., Fer. VI in Parascēvē (Latinitas Precēs)
terms.comment: The Roman Missal’s name for the day.

phrases.latin: quia erat parascēvē, quod est ante sabbatum
phrases.english: because it was the day of Preparation, the day before the Sabbath

sources: Lewis & Short: parasceve · Lewis & Short: feriae
Prayers from the Latinitas Precēs collection (preces.md), checked against the sources named there.
Vulgate verses checked against the Clementine Vulgate (CrossWire VulgClementine, via the scrollmapper bible_databases repository) and Hetzenauer’s edition, in Clementine spelling.
